card.name: Section name Description after 'see'
card.fires_on: The word Description (or Details) naming a section, especially after 'see' or 'refer to' in a cross-reference, or as a heading in a manual page. Also the final S of CONTRAINDICATIONS in a 'see' reference.

modes.label: Cross-reference to Description
modes.description: Section title Description inside brackets or parentheses after 'see'.
modes.example: Do not use FUROSCIX if you see particles or the solution is discolored or cloudy [see<< Description>> ( 11 )] .

modes.label: Manual page heading
modes.description: DESCRIPTION heading that follows the NAME or SYNOPSIS section in a software manual page.
